scope: Additive current Multi-Gear Tower long-range and fast-attack baseline.
game_version: Official February 2025 launch and January 2026 balance notes; exact per-level values are the immutable payload 62b019df.

sources.title: A new Update is here!
sources.limitations: Confirms the merged defense, its two modes, single-target attacks and air/ground targeting, but not numeric range, damage, burst intervals, projectile flight, collision or tick order.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
sources.limitations: Confirms current all-level short-range damage reduction and long-range damage increase, but not replacement per-level tables or timing.

sources.title: Multi-Gear Tower
sources.limitations: Reports 12-tile/1-second long-range and 8-tile/0.192-second/four-shot/0.383-second fast-attack tables, current post-February values and frame-count observation. It does not provide a reproducible client targeting, projectile, collision or tie-order trace.

sources.title: Multi-Gear Tower payload
sources.limitations: Pins L1-L3/Supercharge values, modes, footprint and target metadata, but no client projectile lifecycle.

support.note: Core materializes the documented single-target air/ground long-range and four-shot fast-attack modes through the shared 10-ms tick path. Source intervals 0.192/0.383 s are deterministically quantized to 190/380 ms; projectile flight, collision, client target selection and same-tick ordering remain partial.

known_uncertainties: The exact client target-selection, target-loss, tie and retargeting rules are unpublished.
The source timing has 2-ms and 3-ms remainders relative to kTickMs; Core uses its existing nearest-tick quantization, rather than claiming native client timing.
Projectile trajectory, collision, endpoint, visual asset mapping and mode-switch lifecycle remain unpublished.
conclusion: Multi-Gear Tower has a documented two-mode deterministic Core/Headless/Viewer/RL baseline, with numeric values pinned to a dated secondary payload; flight and client timing fidelity remain partial.
